name: Matrixdock Silver
oneLiner: XAGm is Matrixdock's silver-backed commodity token, with each token representing roughly one troy ounce of LBMA Good Delivery silver vaulted in Asia.
collateral: LBMA-accredited 99.9% Good Delivery silver bars held in Asian vaults under Matrixdock's fractional-reserve-safeguard framework
pegMechanism: Silver-backed commodity token redeemable through Matrixdock for KYC-approved users; issuer materials expose supply, bullion weight, and an oz-per-token metric that may drift slightly from exactly one ounce

mintAuthority.summary: XAGm has issuer-controlled Ethereum and Sui operator paths. Each operator can add local mint budget through a manual budget-receive path, while durable mint execution requires the current four-hour request/execute delay. Ethereum's owner controls delayed UUPS upgrades; Sui's State owner holds the MToken package UpgradeCap.

upgradeability.controlRef: Matrixdock Ethereum MToken UUPS upgrade authority

controls.label: Matrixdock Ethereum XAGm operator
controls.capDescription: The operator can use ccReceiveMintBudgetManually to add local mintBudget without a reserve-feed read. mintTo consumes that budget only after its current 14,400-second request delay.
bypassSurfaces: ccReceiveMintBudgetManually adds local mint budget without a source-side reserve or global-budget check.

sources.label: Matrixdock XAGm PoR and Mint Budget

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535946, operator() returned this code-empty address, mintBudget() was 0, and delay() was 14,400 seconds. Verified MToken source makes ccReceiveMintBudgetManually onlyOperator and increases mintBudget directly; mintTo first stores a request, then permits minting only after the delay and deducts that budget.

controls.label: Matrixdock Ethereum MToken owner
controls.capDescription: The owner can schedule an operator replacement, which can then use the manual budget-receive and mint paths. The current delay is 14,400 seconds; source permits the owner to reduce it no lower than one hour through the existing delayed change path.
bypassSurfaces: The owner can lower the future delay to one hour after the current delayed setDelay process completes.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535946, owner() returned this code-empty address. Verified source restricts setOperator and setDelay to onlyOwner; setOperator's request/effect path uses the current delay. On-chain state showed delay() = 14,400 and nextOperator() equal to the current operator. Off-chain key custody is not disclosed on-chain.

controls.label: Matrixdock Ethereum MToken UUPS upgrade authority
bypassSurfaces: The owner can reduce the future delay to one hour through the current delayed setDelay process before scheduling a later upgrade.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535946, this code-empty owner controlled the UUPS proxy implementation 0x5e072c6689610c66e49a3067a4b488b4e27bc744. DelayedUpgradeable requires onlyOwner to request an upgrade, records an effective time from getDelay(), and its UUPS authorization is onlyOwner; current delay() was 14,400 seconds and no pending implementation was set.

controls.label: Matrixdock Sui XAGm operator
controls.capDescription: The operator can call cc_receive_mint_budget_manually to add local mint_budget. request_mint_to and execute_mint_to require the State's current 14,400-second request delay before TreasuryCap minting.
bypassSurfaces: cc_receive_mint_budget_manually adds local mint budget without an on-chain reserve or global-budget read.
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298761036, shared State 0xc2aa...2b4c listed this address as operator, mint_budget = 0, and delay = 14,400. The current MToken package's disassembly makes cc_receive_mint_budget_manually operator-only and adds its argument to mint_budget; its request_mint_to and execute_mint_to paths are operator-only and delay execution through State.get_effective_time. RPC reports this controller as a non-object address; signer and off-chain custody configuration are not disclosed.

controls.label: Matrixdock Sui XAGm State owner
controls.capDescription: The State owner can request a replacement operator, which becomes effective after the current delay and can then use the local mint-budget and mint paths.
bypassSurfaces: The owner can lower the future delay to one hour through the current delayed request/execute path.
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298761036, shared State 0xc2aa...2b4c listed this address as owner with delay = 14,400. The current MToken package's request_set_operator and execute_set_operator paths check this owner and require State.get_effective_time; request_set_delay accepts no value below 3,600 seconds. RPC reports this controller as a non-object address; signer and off-chain custody configuration are not disclosed.

controls.label: Matrixdock Sui MToken UpgradeCap holder
bypassSurfaces: The Sui UpgradeCap is independently address-owned and policy 0 permits native package upgrades without the State delay.
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298761036, UpgradeCap 0x1a8d...43ee was AddressOwner-held by this non-object address and named current MToken package 0x951c...bf02 with policy = 0 and version = 2. The package upgrade transaction FNtNoUk...pAnZ used package::authorize_upgrade, Upgrade, and package::commit_upgrade directly with that capability; the State's 14,400-second delay is not part of the native UpgradeCap path.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535946, the XAGm proxy resolved to implementation 0x5e072c6689610c66e49a3067a4b488b4e27bc744, owner() was 0xb573c94260582f0715FC477928B04A2708dd36D7, operator() was 0x89Bb23E4a82E04a253d9f11767feDf321C127799, mintBudget() was 0, and delay() was 14,400 seconds. Verified source shows operator-only manual local-budget increases, delayed mint execution, and owner-authorized delayed UUPS replacement. At Sui checkpoint 298761036, shared State 0xc2aa...2b4c listed owner 0x567d...6fb8, operator 0xdb07...aee2, mint_budget 0, delay 14,400, and UpgradeCap 0x1a8d...43ee. That policy-0 UpgradeCap was address-owned by the State owner and controls current MToken package 0x951c...bf02. On-chain data does not disclose the controllers' signer arrangements or off-chain key custody. No completed recurring reconciliation was established as of review. Matrixdock says Bureau Veritas will perform semiannual physical-silver audits, but XAGm launched on 2026-03-17 and the reviewed XAGm underlying-assets page did not expose a dated Bureau Veritas reserve report; the linked smart-contract audit does not reconcile token supply to silver. Matrixdock's dealer certificate is an AML/dealer registration, not exact prudential supervision of the XAGm issuer or product. Reviewed 2026-07-15.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: XAGm is tracked on Ethereum and Sui, and Matrixdock says the Sui deployment is natively issued rather than a wrapped bridge asset. The deployment model is corrected to native-multichain and the route is scored as issuer-native mint/redeem exposure.
